attributes.name: Hide from Animals
attributes.powers:
When any character encounters an ally that has the Animal trait, discard this card; she evades the encounter. Put the ally under the top card of its location deck. That character may explore again.

When any character encounters a non-henchman, non-villain monster that has the Animal trait, discard this card; he evades the encounter and puts the monster on the bottom of its location deck.
attributes.recharge: After playing this card, if you do not have the Divine skill banish it; otherwise, you may succeed at a Divine 8 check to recharge this card instead of discarding it.
